note: GR-18 (Medi 2026-09-25: "Make sure all of her corrections are accounted for and if it doesnt fall into a bucket lets figure out to make one"). A real grammar correction that fits no bucket is a PROPOSED new bucket for Medi's yes/no, never dropped. full_audit_build.py matches each row here by date + moment (5 s) + wrong piece and turns the matched grammar row (or a row rejected only because no bucket fits) into kind 'grammar-propose': listed on the Grammar Console, unscored until Medi's yes. A row the readers already counted under another bucket stays counted there (shown as also_counted_as). medi: null = waiting; 'yes' = add the bucket (scripts/build_grammar_buckets.py) and file the rows; 'no' = the rows stay unscored with his reason. Never delete a row: mark it. On 'yes' with a bucket id, full_audit_build files the moment under that bucket and scores it; a twin already counted at the same moment is refiled (grammar) or marked a duplicate (vocab), so it stays one slip.

proposals.name: pronoun matches who you mean
proposals.proposed_rule: Pick the pronoun for the real person: humma for 'they' (his family), heyye for 'she' (his fiancee), not the last pronoun used.

proposals.name: noun, not verb, after a preposition
proposals.proposed_rule: After bi / fi / min use the noun of the action, not a verb: ana ma3roof bi el-tabe5 (her chat 09-21), not bi a6bo5.
